title: Choosing music; marrying Leotha Elmo
summary: He says music made him happiest after other jobs and names his wife Leotha Elmo.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: And, that's during the period that I was in school, right?
And, is that when you got a banjo, or not? Not then?
No, no. I didn't do that until I went home, and married, and left home again.
Yeah. So in that period before you went back, what you really did was -- went to those theaters, and you heard everything that you could get to hear then.
Yes. Yes, yes.
Yeah, but, did you get to -- form an idea that you would ever make a living in music?
As I can tell you -- I always loved music, you know. It was evidently in me, more or less, you know?
Yeah.
And, because I'd tried-all kinds of jobs, and I was never pleased with whatever I did, you know, until music came, you know. Until I got something musical and-
Yeah.
I was happier --- much happier doing that.
Mm hmm.
But, after leaving -- coming back to New York -- going back to Charleston -- I went back and got married, more or less -- I went back to bury my mother.
Yes.
And, I met my childhood sweetheart.
What's her name? You didn't tell me.
Huh?
What's her name?
Her name was Lectha.
Leotha.
Leotha Elmo.
That's nice.
